title: Massachusetts WNV Municipal Surveillance Dashboard

definitions.Predicted_probability: Modeled probability of at least one reported-positive mosquito sample.
definitions.Predicted_expected_count: Presence probability multiplied by the predicted conditional positive count.
definitions.Predicted_conditional_count: Predicted reported-positive count assuming reported-positive presence occurs.

limitations: No reported-positive detection is not a confirmed negative.
Unknown surveillance effort prevents interpretation as absolute WNV risk.
Suitability does not represent human disease risk or mosquito infection prevalence.
